supported_agent: Claude with exact herdr:claude session reference
install_scope: Explicit user-selected directory on the direct SSH host that owns Herdr and the Claude transcripts. No auto-install, hooks or persistent service.
requirements: Rust 1.85 or later for a source build
Unix host with Claude transcript root readable by the SSH user

steps.description: Build on the target host; Cargo.lock fixes dependency versions
Probe without opening Herdr or reading transcripts

For updates, use the same install command with --replace; symlink destinations are rejected
Open a Claude pane in Herdcats over direct SSH; Timeline launches the helper on demand

removal: Remove only the installed herdcats-bridge file. No daemon, hooks or config are created by this installer.

Public installer smoke verified on Apple Silicon in a temporary directory
Codex, saved-machine routing and native approvals/questions remain gated
